scope: 验证两条基础路线与五增强条件，政策确认后生成固定分支尾声。

named_cases.name: All 32 combinations of five distributed conditions leave the two baseline directions available
Preparation facts remain unpublished before actual Q404 closure; chapter labels and arbitrary receipts do not unlock
Actual six-tower baseline work producer and installed supplies satisfy base readiness without enhancement
Current tower readiness cannot replace scoped verified work, installed quantities or actual local duties
Current version and appointment instances independently invalidate distributed eligibility without blocking baseline
Departure requires actual transferred vessel instance and current border work; civil ferry or task labels grant no ownership
Unaccepted optional work does not block departure; accepted onsite work requires safe handover or explicit suspension
Cargo in transit and an incomplete current risk register are explicit departure blockers
Sealing requires a genuine protected checkpoint, locks installed quantities and performs no narrative closure or reward
Checkpoint metadata mismatch or concurrent world change cannot commit preparation
Central stabilization supplies safety only and never selects policy, fabricates final activity or grants a reward
Policy confirmation requires current actual final control; prose changes invalidate an old action preview
All three actual SQLite ending commits award once, preserve responsibility and world history, and replay epilogues without assessment
Frozen agreements survive irrelevant later preferences; sealed material depletion is caught atomically even after preview
Revoked actual control between preview and transaction rejects the ending without any partial reward
Unknown commit outcome retries the identical command and resolves one fixed snapshot and reward
Prefinal load starts a different adventure outcome while the original ending remains immutable and old preview is rejected

evidence.remaining: Actual later producers, native player experience and required human/versioned approvals are not inferred from engineering fixtures.
